title: Risk-calibrated security request onramp and DPA exception flow
creator: Aria Patel
description: Introduce a risk-calibrated intake onramp for security and compliance asks to reduce human triage, speed SLA commitments, and provide a clear exception flow for DPAs and regionally sensitive requests. The flow should produce an evidence lane (auto-collected docs + manual tasks), map requests to a risk band (Low/Medium/High/Regulated), and surface required SLAs and owner routing. High/regulatory requests (HIPAA, GDPR+Data Residency, certain SOC2/ISO evidence gaps) should trigger an automated DPA exception checklist and a fast-path to Solutions Engineering + Legal review. The system must integrate with Zendesk ticket tags and the internal intake form, output a machine-readable summary for Eng/Design, and provide a dashboard view for weekly backlog planning.
acceptance_criteria: Automated scoring engine prototype that assigns risk band from intake fields and uploaded questionnaire (P0 fields validated)
Evidence lane templates created for Low/Medium/High/Regulated with checklist steps and default owners
DPA exception flow that creates a Legal review task, attaches a prepopulated DPA summary, and flags the ticket SLA to 10 business days for High/Regulated
Integration with Zendesk such that tags and priority map back to Linear ticket fields and update routing
Dashboard widget in Console-ops showing pending security asks by risk band and expected SLA breaches
End-to-end manual test with a sample HIPAA request and a sample vendor questionnaire demonstrating routing and artifact bundling
